name: Open Task in New Window { Id }
purpose: Opens a task in a new window: requires an Id parameter, sets selector::ActivityId from it and opens the "Task Detail" layout for the related Selected_Activity_Task record in a 1080x800 window focused on the subject.
open_question: Step 8 reads the "Id" key of the parameter (a JSON object), while the empty check at step 3 and the dialog say "ID"; callers pass JSON {Id}. A card-window variant (step 10) is disabled.

name: Add/Edit Activity Party to Activity { ActivityPartyRoleId }
purpose: Adds or updates a party in a role on the current activity: validates that ActivityPartyRoleId is present, sets the selector globals (activity, party, role) to look for an existing activity party in that role, then calls "Create ActivityParty { json }" or "Edit ActivityParty { json }" in karbon_kontroller (edit when a match by role exists), shows an error dialog on failure, closes the popover and commits.
writes:
selector::ActivityId#7 (Set Field step 74, global)
selector::PartyId#6 (Set Field step 75, global)
selector::ActivityPartyRoleId#29 (Set Field step 76, global)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/376 "Create ActivityParty { json }" (step 84) [other file: karbon_kontroller]
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/631 "Edit ActivityParty { json }" (step 88) [other file: karbon_kontroller]
open_question: The final Exit Script is always 0 (step 105): errors from the setup commit, JSON validation (Exit Loop If at steps 32, 46, 52) are swallowed and never returned or shown. $Comments, $ContactMethodId, $EmailAddress, $EmailAddressFormatted, $Rsvp and $RsvpInd are never set, so they are sent empty and an edit blanks existing comments/RSVP/email values. Match by role uses the Selected_ActivityParty#matchByRole relationship (activity + role + party). Script is in the Scripts menu (includeInMenu=True).
